prompt:
Build a closed-loop tiltrotor VTOL flight model in Simulink. The plant must contain a finite-mass six-degree-of-freedom rigid body, aerodynamic and propulsion forces, four rotor paths, two independently actuated front-rotor tilt paths, conventional aerodynamic control surfaces, gravity and ground interaction. A mission manager and feedback controller must support hover waypoint flight, a controlled hover-to-fixed-wing transition, and fixed-wing waypoint or orbit flight. Vehicle motion must result from the connected actuator, propulsion, aerodynamic and rigid-body dynamics; prescribed motion or replayed state histories are not valid solutions.

Read MissionKind, InitialFlightMode, MissionProfile, PayloadScale, EnableWind and SimulationDuration_s from the MATLAB base workspace. MissionProfile uses the public operation codes and column order in the input contract. Support the full stated payload range and both calm and wind-enabled operation.

MissionKind is a scalar integer in {1, 2, 3} for hover waypoint, hover-to-fixed-wing transition, and fixed-wing waypoint-orbit missions; InitialFlightMode is a scalar integer 0 (hover) or 2 (fixed wing); MissionProfile is an N-by-8 real matrix ordered [mission operation code, north position (m), east position (m), down position (m), operation parameters 1-4], with operation codes 1 (arm or initialize), 2 (track waypoint), 3 (track orbit using columns 5-8), 4 (land), and 6 (change between hover and forward-flight configuration); PayloadScale is a real scalar in [0.9, 1.1] (multiplicative mass factor); EnableWind is a scalar logical; and SimulationDuration_s is a real scalar in [30, 60] s. During each mission, track the commanded path with bounded position, altitude, attitude and body-rate errors. The transition must acquire forward airspeed while continuously tilting the front rotors and avoiding excessive altitude loss or prolonged command saturation. All actuator commands must be causally connected to the vehicle plant, and measured vehicle state must close the flight-control loop.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named PositionTracking, TransitionState, VehicleState, and ActuatorCommand. PositionTracking has 6 channels in this order: commanded north, east, and down position, followed by measured north, east, and down position, all in m. TransitionState has 4 channels in this order: airspeed (m/s), front-rotor tilt angle (rad), pitch angle (rad), and altitude above the local ground plane (m). VehicleState has 13 channels in this order: north, east, and down position (m); north, east, and down velocity (m/s); roll, pitch, and yaw (rad); body roll, pitch, and yaw rate (rad/s); and airspeed (m/s). ActuatorCommand has 10 channels in this order: front-left, front-right, rear-right, and rear-left rotor-speed commands in rev/s; front-left and front-right rotor-tilt commands (rad); aileron, elevator, and rudder commands (rad); and the forward-thrust rotor-speed-increment command in rev/s. Measurements must come from the connected mission, control, actuator and physical plant paths that determine vehicle motion. Save the completed model as cand_XAERO04.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAERO04.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
